Shows that air under the "American History TV" banner cover the history of the nation, from its founding in the 18th century through modern times. Topics covered include the Civil War, presidents and the exploration of historical sites.

channel.title: new! Pope Leo Xiv In San Marino And Rimini

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Art Of Faith With Fr. Patrick Van Der Vorst

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Pope Leo Xiv In San Marino And Rimini
channel.desc: Pope Leo offers prayers along with priests,consecrated men and women, and representatives of the ecclesial life of the diocese. From the Basilica of San Marino. (45 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Father Spitzer?s Universe
channel.desc: Fr. Spitzer answers viewer questions on a wide range of subjects, including: Reason, Faith, Suffering, Virtue, and the Existence of God. (60 minutes).[(96057)]
